verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a first-party Exports API covering customers, screening, cases, profiles, payment and transaction-monitoring cases, and transactions, filtered by date range. It also offers a case audit-trail endpoint, and transaction data can be exported as CSV for use outside the platform. However, file formats are documented only for transaction data, download URLs expire after 5 seconds, and nothing shows that configurations or risk-scoring settings can be exported or covers account offboarding. Missing for 10: documented open formats for all export types, proof that exports cover all account data (configurations, risk models, audit logs in bulk), offboarding/data-deletion guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.
